en: A two-mission submarine campaign in the central South China Sea. Hunt a Russian Yasen through a covert breakout
de: then contain the wider regional escalation gathering around it.

en: Your Virginia-class submarine has been pushed into the central South China Sea to intercept a Russian breakout. A Yasen-class submarine, screened by an Akula escort and masked by neutral shipping, is attempting to slip west across the theater. Build the picture, hold contact, and kill the Yasen before it crosses the barrier line.
Keep your submarine combat effective and raise antennas to conclude the mission.

BT
SUBJ: TASKING ORDER

1. A Russian Yasen-class submarine has entered the central South China Sea with at least one escort and is moving west toward the barrier line.

2. Neutral merchant traffic is present in the area and may complicate the picture. Expect biologics and deep thermal conditions.

3. Primary task:
   A. Keep your submarine combat effective and raise antennas whenever you want to conclude the mission.

4. Additional guidance:
   A. The escort is likely an Akula variant operating in close support.
   B. The last known datum, barrier line, and withdrawal box are attached.
   C. Weapons free on confirmed hostile submarines if you choose to prosecute.

5. Do not let the target escape west.

SUBJ: MISSION STATUS - SUCCESS

The Yasen was neutralized before crossing the barrier. COMSUBLANT assesses the breakout attempt defeated.
